name: pdf-render-service
description: CargoDesk's second extracted microservice — renders self-contained HTML into a raw PDF buffer via a real installed browser (Puppeteer). Stateless, no database. Called only by the monolith (lib/pdf-signing.js), which still owns cert lookup + signing itself — the signing key never leaves the monolith. Resolved dependencies (express, puppeteer-core) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step, matching services/document-distribution's own convention.
